misconceptions.description: Collecting student feedback for show without letting it carry weight in the decision
misconceptions.trigger: candidate uses claps, cherry-picked quotes, or skips voice while citing scores
misconceptions.feedback: Gather feedback fairly, report the patterns, and name the change that follows. Voice must influence the decision.

misconceptions.description: Averaging feedback in a way that erases a subgroup's distinct concern
misconceptions.trigger: candidate reports a majority average while dropping low subgroup ratings as outliers
misconceptions.feedback: Surface the subgroup split and act on the named barrier before averaging away the students the audit should protect.

misconceptions.description: Accepting AI-generated themes that quietly drop critical or minority student comments
misconceptions.trigger: candidate reports AI themes without checking them against the raw comments
misconceptions.feedback: Read the raw comments yourself, restore dropped critical ones, and verify AI themes against what students wrote.

misconceptions.description: Treating a completed survey as proof that student voice shaped the decision
misconceptions.trigger: candidate records completion or a satisfaction chart but no resulting change
misconceptions.feedback: Show the line from feedback to the change you made, and tell students how their input was used.
